notes: Fan-out limit contract for a small launcher: Server Concurrent Sessions = 1 (mirrored into the launcher's Max local subagents at once) admits ONE local sibling per wave; the extra sibling gets a retryable `unavailable` verdict naming the limit and the model re-sends it in the next message. A model that serializes on its own (two one-call messages) also passes — what is pinned is that a limit of 1 never loses a job. Bundle generation defaults stay authoritative.
